B1: Choosing Useful Technology

Quality checked lesson

Technology is not useful just because it is new or popular. A useful tool solves a real problem in a simple way. It may save time, reduce stress, help you study, or support your work.

Warm-Up Questions

  1. What technology do you use every day?

  2. Which tool or app saves you the most time?

  3. Have you ever bought or downloaded something useful at first, but later stopped using it?

  4. When do you think technology becomes a distraction instead of a help?
